note: What people are actually searching for and buying this season. Refreshed every morning in December.

groups.title: Gifts for the whole friend group
groups.why: Searches for personalised friend gifts are up hugely this season, and 'Friendsmas' supplies are up too.

items.n: Best friend book to fill in
Pet Christmas bauble with their name

groups.title: Craftmas: make it together
groups.why: Festive craft nights are the new Christmas party. DIY activity searches have exploded.

groups.title: Maximalist, sparkly and a bit extra
groups.why: 'Merrymaxxing' is the mood: rhinestones, bold colour and baubles with personality.

groups.title: Handmade you can see
groups.why: Visible brushstrokes and hand stitching are a sign of quality, not a flaw. Hand-painted and hand-woven searches are way up.

groups.title: For the host
groups.why: People are dressing their tables like outfits: ruffles, lace and custom napkins.

groups.title: Party dressing with drama
groups.why: Capelets, vintage jewellery and brooches are back for the festive party season.
